The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: a grown-up person.

draft.emotion: respectful and slightly deferential, speaking of someone with authority
notes: Composed of ผู้ (person) and ใหญ่ (big/great). It covers both biological adults and figures of authority.
Do not confuse with คนโต (the eldest person in a group); ผู้ใหญ่ is specifically someone who has reached adulthood or holds a senior administrative role.

senses.definition: A person who is fully grown or of legal age, no longer a child.

examples.text: เรื่องนี้ผู้ใหญ่ต้องเป็นคนตัดสินใจ
examples.translation: For this matter, the adults have to be the ones to decide.
examples.emotion: firm and matter-of-fact, stating how responsibilities are divided

senses.definition: A person in a position of authority, leadership, or senior status in a community, such as a village headman.

examples.text: เราควรไป ผู้ใหญ่ บ้านเพื่อขอคำแนะนำ
examples.translation: We should go see the village headman to ask for advice.
examples.emotion: polite and seeking guidance from someone respected
